snapshot.title: Contractor Selection Screen — Component Spec

changes.newValue:
## Overview

The contractor selection screen is **Step 1** of the LaunchWizard flow (after the welcome/mission-intro step). It lets the player commit to a mining contract before selecting a target and rocket. The player picks one of 2–3 contractor companies; each contractor specifies which minerals they want and pays a bonus on top of the standard market rate when those minerals are delivered.

---

## Where It Lives

| Location | Path |
|---|---|
| Step builder | `scene/Scripts/UI/LaunchWizard.gd` — `_build_contractor_step()` |
| Card builder | `scene/Scripts/UI/LaunchWizard.gd` — `_add_contractor_card()` |
| Card template (unselected) | `scene/Scenes/UI/Templates/LaunchWizardContractorCard.tscn` |
| Card template (selected) | `scene/Scenes/UI/Templates/LaunchWizardContractorCardSelected.tscn` |
| Contractor data (M1) | `scene/Scripts/Utils/RocketsMissionData.gd` — `STARTER_CONTRACTOR_OFFERS` |
| Contractor data (M2+) | `scene/Scripts/Utils/RocketsMissionData.gd` — `FREE_OPS_CONTRACTOR_OFFERS` |
| Data resolution | `scene/Scripts/Utils/RocketsManager.gd` — `get_starter_contractors()` / `ensure_trip_contract_offer()` |

---

## Visual Layout

The screen occupies the main content area of the LaunchWizard modal. Top to bottom:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MISSION 1 // PICK A BUYER                              │  ← _contractor_title (Label)
│  Companies pay you to mine specific minerals…           │  ← _contractor_subtitle (Label)
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ [ADS] │ Aegis Defense Systems          [SELECT] │   │  ← contractor card row
│  │       │ Defense-grade avionics…                 │   │
│  │       │ 6× Iron  4× Nickel                      │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ [LCL] │ Lumen Consumer Labs            [SELECT] │   │
│  │       │ High-volume consumer electronics…       │   │
│  │       │ 5× Iron  5× Nickel                      │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ [HOW] │ Helion Orbital Works           [SELECT] │   │
│  │       │ Next-gen propulsion…                    │   │
│  │       │ 4× Iron  6× Nickel                      │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  Custom Mission: LOCKED — Unlocks after M1      │   │  ← _custom_mission_card
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [BACK]        SYSTEM STATUS OPTIMAL        [PROCEED]  │  ← footer
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Cards stack vertically in a single-column `GridContainer` (`_contractor_grid`, columns = 1).

---

## Card Scene Composition

Each card is a `PanelContainer` instantiated from one of two templates depending on selection state.

### Node tree

```
LaunchWizardContractorCard (PanelContainer)
└── Margin (MarginContainer) — 20px left/right, 18px top/bottom
    └── HBox (HBoxContainer) — separation 20px
        ├── BadgePanel (PanelContainer) — 80×80px, vertically centred
        │   └── BadgeLabel (Label) — 26px, centred; e.g. "ADS", "LCL", "HOW"
        ├── InfoCol (VBoxContainer) — expands horizontally, separation 8px
        │   ├── NameLabel (Label) — 34px white; contractor name
        │   ├── FocusLabel (Label) — 17px blue-white, wraps; full role description
        │   └── MineralsLabel (Label) — 16px muted; e.g. "6× Iron  4× Nickel"
        └── SelectButton (Button) — 156×64px min, vertically centred
```

### Visual states

| State | Card border | Badge border | Button |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unselected | 1px, `#3f9ee0` 40% | 1px, `#3f9ee0` 55% | "SELECT", muted border |
| Selected | 2px, `#40adff` solid, blue glow shadow | 2px, `#59c2ff` 90% | "SELECTED", bright filled border |

---

## Data Flow

### Where contractor lists come from

**Mission 1 (starter contract):**
- Source: `RocketsMissionData.STARTER_CONTRACTOR_OFFERS` (3 hardcoded entries)
- Retrieved via: `RocketsManager.get_starter_contractors()` after `ensure_starter_contract_offer()`
- Each entry has: `id`, `name`, `focus`, `requested_minerals` (Dict of mineral→quantity)

**Mission 2+ / Free Ops (trip contract):**
- Source: `RocketsMissionData.FREE_OPS_CONTRACTOR_OFFERS` (sampled into a trip offer)
- Retrieved via: `RocketsManager.ensure_trip_contract_offer()` → `offer["contractors"]`
- Each entry has: `id`, `name`, `role`, `mineral_ranges` (resolved to quantities by RocketsManager)

The `_build_contractor_step()` function checks `_use_trip_contract` (true when `_is_free_ops or stage >= 2`) and fetches from the appropriate source.

### Selection

Tapping SELECT on a card:
1. Sets `_selected_contractor` to that contractor's dict
2. Calls `RocketsManager.select_trip_contractor(id)` or `select_starter_contractor(id)` to persist the choice
3. Calls `_rebuild_cards()` — clears and rebuilds the grid so the chosen card swaps to the Selected template
4. Calls `_update_footer()` — enables the PROCEED button

The currently selected contractor is tracked by comparing `c["id"]` against `_selected_contractor["id"]` on each rebuild.

---

## Label Population

`_add_contractor_card()` sets labels via `_set_label_text(card, NodePath, value)`:

| Node path | Value source |
|---|---|
| `Margin/HBox/BadgePanel/BadgeLabel` | `_badge_code(c_name)` — initials (e.g. "ADS") |
| `Margin/HBox/InfoCol/NameLabel` | `c["name"]` |
| `Margin/HBox/InfoCol/FocusLabel` | `c["focus"]` or `c["role"]` |
| `Margin/HBox/InfoCol/MineralsLabel` | `_minerals_text(c["requested_minerals"])` — e.g. "6× Iron  4× Nickel" |
| `Margin/HBox/SelectButton` text | `"SELECTED"` if selected else `"SELECT"` |

### Badge code logic (`_badge_code`)

Multi-word name → take first letter of each word up to 3 (e.g. "Aegis Defense Systems" → "ADS").  
Single word → first 3 characters uppercased (e.g. "Rocketlab" → "ROC").

### Minerals text logic (`_minerals_text`)

Joins all mineral entries as `"Nname"` pairs separated by two spaces:
- `{"Iron": 6, "Nickel": 4}` → `"6× Iron  4× Nickel"`
- Empty dict → `"Collect anything"`

---

## Custom Mission Card

Below the contractor rows, `_custom_mission_card` is always shown. In M1 it displays a locked notice. It becomes interactive after the first mission completes.

---

## Footer Behaviour

- PROCEED is disabled until a contractor is selected (`_selected_contractor` is non-empty)
- `_update_footer()` is called after every selection change to re-evaluate the PROCEED state
- The centre status label shows "SYSTEM STATUS OPTIMAL" when the wizard is in a valid state
